question: {Simplify: } sec²Phi cot²Phi - (1)/(tan²Phi) + 2( (1)/(csc²Phi) + (1)/(sec²Phi) )
solution:
**Given:**

 sec²Phi cot²Phi - dfrac{1}{tan²Phi} + 2Big( dfrac{1}{csc²Phi} + dfrac{1}{sec²Phi} Big)

**Formula used:**

cot = cos/sin, tan = sin/cos, sec = 1/cos, csc = 1/sin

1 + cot²Φ = csc²Φ

sin²Φ + cos²Φ = 1

**Calculations:**

⇒ sec²Phi cot²Phi = dfrac{1}{cos²Phi}·dfrac{cos²Phi}{sin²Phi} = dfrac{1}{sin²Phi} = csc²Phi 

⇒ dfrac{1}{tan²Phi} = cot²Phi 

⇒ First two terms: csc²Phi - cot²Phi = 1 

⇒ dfrac{1}{csc²Phi} + dfrac{1}{sec²Phi} = sin²Phi + cos²Phi = 1 

⇒ Last part: 2times 1 = 2

⇒ Total = 1 + 2 = 3

**∴ Simplified value = 3.**
